blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marcos administration’s much-awaited second-half pickup in infrastructure spending got off to a weak start in July as the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) continued to weigh on overall expenditures. However, the downturn eased considerably from previous months. In July, the decline in infrastructure spending finally limited itself to single digits, after it had fallen by more than 30 percent in every month from January to June.
